detail.longDescription: Many of you might be familiar with Omnivore. It was a cloud-hosted Read it Later app that later shutdown due to the owners going to work for ElevenLabs. If you are familiar with it, you'll know that it was a pretty feature-filled reader that became an essential part of peoples reading / articling habit. Shortly before the shutdown I was tasked with ensuring that Omnivore could live on as a self-hosted application. By the time the Omnivore application shut down there was a fully-self hostable version available. I didn't do much to advertise this at the time. We had a pretty sturdy community on Discord and those who needed that information found it. I wanted to advertise it now because I have made a few changes to the setup, and I figured it might be a nice time for people to jump in. I've included a link in the URL with a bunch of screenshots and feature outlines.
